_scanner_note: Active scanner: 'ml' = LivePaperInferenceProvider with champion model | 'legacy' = deterministic OptionScanner. Override with --scanner CLI flag.
_ml_scanner_note: ML inference scanner — default candidate-generation path. LivePaperInferenceProvider loads the champion model from registry_path, scores short-option candidates against current Alpaca market data, and returns model-ranked PCS/CCS picks. Execution flows through the same Alpaca paper account as the legacy scanner.

ml_scanner._provider_note: Leave empty to use LivePaperInferenceProvider directly (recommended). Set to 'module:Class' only for a custom inference provider.
ml_scanner._registry_path_note: Single source of truth for the generic champion ranker. PCS and CCS candidates are both scored by this registry champion.
ml_scanner._data_provider_note: Leave empty to use AlpacaProvider.from_env() (paper=alpaca.paper). Set to 'module:Class' for a custom market-data provider.
ml_scanner._min_score_note: Reject candidates whose model score is below this threshold. 0.0 = accept all positively-scored candidates.
ml_scanner._max_dte_note: Maximum DTE for live ML entries. Keep spreads inside a 2-3 week theta-decay window while leaving the champion model's ranking logic unchanged.
ml_scanner._lookback_note: Days of historical stock bars fetched per ticker for feature computation (realized-vol, momentum, regime).
ml_scanner._forward_days_note: Lookahead window (days) for event features: earnings, dividends, FOMC.
ml_scanner._chain_fetch_workers_note: Concurrent option-chain fetches during live scanning. Higher is faster for large universes, but increases Alpaca request concurrency.
ml_scanner._spread_widths_note: Dollar widths evaluated for each PCS/CCS short leg. Multiple widths let the model score and rank different risk/reward profiles per expiry; the highest-scored width wins selection.
ml_scanner._large_loss_classifier_note: V007b LLC: retrained on 500K DTE≤21 balanced dataset. AUC 0.839, recall 99.7%, 47 FN. Defensive 0.70 threshold prioritizes avoiding large realized losses over preserving every capital-efficient short-DTE pick.
ml_scanner._stop_loss_classifier_note: V007b SLC: retrained on 500K DTE≤21 balanced dataset. AUC 0.797, recall 99.5%. Ultra-defensive 0.15 threshold matches the artifact's high-recall operating point and prioritizes avoiding intraday stop-loss exits over candidate volume or per-trade RoR maximisation.

_pick_selection_note: model_ranked = pure top-N by model score, with no per-strategy floors or regime-driven PCS/CCS overrides (right choice for ML scanner). equal_diversity = guaranteed floor per strategy (legacy default).
_legacy_scanner_note: The following scanner/strategy settings are retained for legacy tests/reference and old risk/execution compatibility. They are not the north-star candidate-generation path.
_universe_note: etf = curated stable ETF preset for live options selling (default). etf-all = all ETFs on NASDAQ/NYSE/NYSE Arca. Other options: index (S&P500+NDX100+Dow30) | default (NASDAQ/NYSE stocks by market cap) | full (alias for default).
_perf_note: Legacy deterministic scanner setting retained for reference/tests.
_blacklist_note: Legacy deterministic scanner setting retained for reference/tests. Future ML candidate filtering should be model/provider driven.

alpaca._credentials_note: Leave api_key/api_secret blank and set ALPACA_API_KEY + ALPACA_API_SECRET env vars instead — env vars take priority and keep secrets out of git.
alpaca._approve_mode_note: true=interactive approve gate | false/'auto'=auto-execute every pick that survives the ML pipeline | 'scan-only'=never execute
alpaca._high_confidence_mode_note: Informational runtime flag: live trade selection is enforced by the ML pipeline plus HFT Alpaca-only market data.
alpaca._auto_execute_prob_note: Legacy no-op retained for compatibility. Auto mode no longer filters by prob_win; the ML pipeline is the gate.

risk_parameters._auto_execute_prob_note: Legacy compatibility field only; live auto-mode does not use a probability threshold.
risk_parameters._stop_loss_note: Legacy guard: close when current_mark > multiplier × entry_premium. Still active but the width-relative guard below is the primary trigger for spreads.
risk_parameters._stop_loss_max_loss_note: Primary spread guard: close when unrealised loss exceeds this fraction of max possible loss (spread_width - entry_premium). 0.80 = exit when 80% of width is lost. Set to null to disable (legacy multiplier only).
risk_parameters._interval_note: How often the position monitor polls for stop-loss triggers during market hours (default 15). Lower values give tighter intraday protection at the cost of more API calls.
risk_parameters._new_position_grace_note: Do not fire stop-loss, profit-take, or gamma-risk exits on freshly opened positions until this many minutes have passed. Prevents noisy immediate closeouts while fills, quotes, and broker greeks settle.

max_loss_multiple._note: Reject new trades whose max loss per contract is too large relative to collected credit. 30.0 means do not risk more than $30 for each $1 collected.

complex_spread_quantity_cap._note: Cap IC/IFLY quantity to max_quantity when one contract would consume at least this fraction of the per-symbol stress cap.

portfolio_gamma_risk._note: Account-level short-gamma gate. Simulates existing open/pending-close positions plus each candidate pick under +/- index shocks and IV expansion, then reduces or rejects new trades if hard stress-loss limits breach. Per-symbol stress caps prevent one ETF from dominating tail risk. 1% gamma-loss/theta is warning-only by default; expiry bucket cap is disabled by default.

risk_parameters._profit_take_note: Close any open position once this fraction of the entry premium has been captured as profit (pnl / entry_premium >= profit_take_pct). 0.75 = close when 75% of collected credit is locked in. Set profit_take_enabled to false or profit_take_pct to 0.0 to disable.

gamma_risk._gamma_risk_note: Dynamic early-exit based on Black-Scholes Greeks. Closes a position when gamma is outpacing theta income AND the short leg delta is moving ITM — aiming to lock in remaining premium before it erodes.
gamma_risk._ratio_note: Close when |net_gamma| / |net_theta_per_day| >= this value. Higher means gamma risk per dollar of daily theta income is too high. 1.5 = default; lower for more aggressive protection.
gamma_risk._delta_note: Only fire the gamma trigger when |short_delta| >= this value, indicating the short leg is not safely OTM.
gamma_risk._profit_note: Require at least this fraction of entry_premium to have been captured (pnl/entry_premium >= threshold) before allowing an early close. Avoids closing a newly opened position immediately.
gamma_risk._urgent_note: If |short_delta| >= this value, bypass min_profit_captured_pct and close regardless — position has moved deeply ITM and is in urgent danger. Also serves as the near-expiry (DTE<=1) threshold when ratio-based check is bypassed.

ml_exit_risk._note: Primary proactive exit model for open positions. Loads the champion from artifacts/risk_model_registry.json and closes when score >= threshold. Aggressive mode uses one confirmation so ML can exit on the first validated risk signal; deterministic stop-loss remains active as the final fallback; gamma-risk manual close is disabled in live config.

vix_filter._note: Legacy scanner note. VIX is now primarily used by account-level regime/risk controls, not deterministic candidate generation.

regime_filter._note: Classifies market regime before opening new trades. GREEN trades normally; YELLOW/ORANGE reduce scan count and quantity; RED pauses new openings while still monitoring existing positions.

sentiment._sentiment_disabled_note: Disabled for ETF/index universe. RSI/SMA momentum signals are designed for individual stocks; broad-market ETFs do not exhibit the same single-name momentum patterns and the signals add noise.
sentiment._sentiment_note: BULL → raise PCS max_delta + top-N quota, lower CCS delta + quota. BEAR → opposite. NEUTRAL → no change. top_n_skew_factor controls pick-count reallocation (0.50 = up to ±50% of base top_n shifted between PCS and CCS).

covered_put._note: DISABLED — ties up full cash collateral (strike x 100)

put_credit_spread._oi_note: Raised to 100 for ETF universe — liquid ETF options carry deep OI; low OI indicates an illiquid strike or a thinly-traded ETF.

iron_condor._ic_allocation_note: DISABLED by default after backtests showed IC tail losses outweighed upside. If enabled, IC picks are capped at ic_allocation_pct × top_n slots to prevent condors from crowding out PCS/CCS.
iron_condor._high_iv_note: For ETFs with HV30 >= high_iv_threshold (40%), use wider wing widths to provide more cushion against gamma moves.

iron_butterfly._note: DISABLED — ATM short put + ATM short call + OTM wings. Capital = max(wing_width,wing_width) x 100. Higher premium than IC; profits when stock stays near entry price.

short_strangle._note: DISABLED — naked options require large margin

covered_call._note: DISABLED — requires owning 100 shares (stock_price x 100 capital)

_email_note: Remove or leave empty to disable email notifications entirely.
_schedule_note: Used only when running with --daemon. run_time is local 24-h HH:MM. weekdays_only skips Saturday/Sunday.
_monitor_schedule_note: Used when running position_monitor.py --daemon. Checks stop-losses every run_interval_minutes during market_open..market_close window (24-h HH:MM, local timezone).

monitor_schedule._weekly_digest_note: Send a weekly summary email every Friday after market close. Includes week P&L, cumulative P&L, capital deployed, win rate, best/worst trade, and open-position risk breakdown.
monitor_schedule._reconcile_note: How often the Alpaca↔DB reconciliation daemon runs (seconds). Runs independently of market hours and the risk cycle. Default 300 (5 min). Resolves PENDING opens, PENDING_CLOSE rows, ghost EXECUTED positions, and logs orphan Alpaca positions.
monitor_schedule._ghost_grace_note: EXECUTED positions created within this many minutes are exempt from ghost detection. In auto mode the agent and reconciler run concurrently; Alpaca MLEG fills can take several seconds to appear in the positions API. 10 min = 2× the default reconcile interval.

_earnings_note: ETFs do not have earnings announcements — this filter is disabled for the ETF universe.
_otm_pct_note: Hard floor on how far OTM the short strike must be, independent of delta. ETFs are more range-bound than individual stocks — 4% provides adequate buffer without sacrificing too much premium.
_dynamic_width_note: Scale strike width with underlying price. ETFs trade at higher prices (SPY ~$550, QQQ ~$480) so wider tiers are needed to keep the spread a meaningful % of spot. Tiers are evaluated in order; first tier whose max_price >= spot wins.
_iv_filters_note: IV rank filter is disabled for the ETF universe. Index ETFs carry a structural volatility risk premium (VIX effect) that makes the HV-rank gate unreliable — it would incorrectly block ETFs during low-VIX regimes when conditions are actually ideal for premium selling.

iv_filters._iv_rank_note: Skip tickers where HV rank < this threshold. HV rank = percentile of current 30-day realised vol within its 1-year range (0.30 = bottom 30th percentile filtered out). Requires history_days of price history.
iv_filters._iv_premium_note: Skip tickers where ATM implied vol < HV30 × iv_premium_min_ratio. Ensures you are selling options priced richer than recent realised vol — the core edge of premium selling.
iv_filters._ratio_note: Minimum ratio of ATM_IV / HV30 required. 1.0 = IV must at least equal HV30. 1.10 = IV must be 10% above HV30.
iv_filters._history_note: Trading days of price history to fetch for HV rank computation. 252 = 1 year. Increasing this costs more API bandwidth per scan cycle.

_chain_liquidity_note: Chain-level liquidity pre-filter applied once per expiry before strategy scanning. Raised min_open_interest and min_bid for ETF universe — liquid ETF options have deep OI and tight spreads; low values indicate illiquid strikes.

chain_liquidity._note: min_bid: skip options with bid < $0.10. min_open_interest: skip if OI < 100. max_spread_pct: skip if (ask-bid)/bid > 30% (tight for liquid ETFs).

_atr_note: ATR-based distance guard: require |spot - short_strike| >= multiplier × ATR(atr_period). Multiplier raised to 2.0 for ETF universe — ETF ATR is tighter than individual stocks so a higher multiplier maintains adequate cushion.
_hft_note: Set hft_mode=true to activate high-frequency trading mode: Alpaca-only data (no yfinance fallback), broker-supplied greeks from snapshots, fast polling. Requires valid ALPACA_API_KEY + ALPACA_API_SECRET.

hft._poll_note: How often the HFT daemon polls Alpaca for fresh option snapshots (seconds). Default 15. monitor_schedule.run_interval_minutes is ignored when hft_mode=true.
hft._retry_note: Number of retry attempts before giving up on an Alpaca call. No yfinance fallback in HFT mode — failed calls raise an error after exhausting retries.
hft._delay_note: Base delay for exponential back-off: attempt 1 = base, attempt 2 = 2×base, attempt 3 = 4×base.
